openFindings.title: CLI workspace manifest was deleted instead of relocated
openFindings.description: The root workspace declares `runtime/cli`, but no `runtime/cli/package.json` exists, the old `scripts/package.json` is deleted, and root test scripts still invoke `--workspace=@spec-kit/scripts`; the nested CLI cannot be addressed as the declared workspace.

openFindings.title: CLI workspace manifest was deleted instead of relocated
openFindings.description: Root workspaces names runtime/cli, runtime/cli/package.json is absent, scripts/package.json is deleted, root scripts still target @spec-kit/scripts, and package-lock retains the scripts link.
openFindings.scopeProof: Direct manifest reads, git tree inspection, and package-lock comparison within the bounded scope.

openFindings.title: Execution verification retains a retired compiled path
openFindings.description: The handoff still runs `runtime/cli/dist/memory/generate-context.js`, while the implementation summary identifies the shipped writer as `runtime/cli/dist/continuity/generate-context.js` at `implementation-summary.md:55-60` and the root smoke scripts use the continuity path.

openFindings.title: Execution verification retains a retired compiled path
openFindings.description: The execution plan invokes runtime/cli/dist/memory/generate-context.js, but implementation-summary.md and package scripts use runtime/cli/dist/continuity/generate-context.js.
openFindings.scopeProof: Direct reads of the execution plan, implementation summary, and root package scripts.

openFindings.title: Root Vitest configuration omits the moved CLI test root
openFindings.description: Root Vitest includes scripts/tests but not runtime/cli/tests; scripts/tests has zero regular files while runtime/cli/tests contains 146 top-level Vitest suites, and runtime/vitest.config.ts excludes runtime/cli.
openFindings.scopeProof: Direct config reads plus bounded filesystem counts of the old and moved test roots.
openFindings.dimension: correctness of build/test discovery and maintainability of the verification contract. f003 is an active p1. no source or packet files were modified.

openFindings.title: Packet metadata and completion documents disagree about level and status
openFindings.description: spec.md reports Level 3 and Complete while frontmatter remains Level 2; plan remains planning-only with an unchecked Definition of Done; acceptance remains Planned while implementation and tasks report completion; generated description and graph causal summary retain the old sibling layout.
openFindings.scopeProof: Direct packet-document reads plus independent SHA-256 comparison of all four graph-metadata source documents.

openFindings.title: Moved CLI READMEs retain retired scripts paths and invalid build commands
openFindings.description: Persistent package documentation describes scripts/ and memory/ topology and uses npm --prefix system-spec-kit/scripts commands although scripts/package.json is absent and the workspace destination is runtime/cli.
openFindings.scopeProof: Direct reads of the moved package README command blocks and filesystem confirmation that the old package manifest is absent.

openFindings.scopeProof: Direct registry read, neighboring loader read, and bounded existence check against the moved source tree.
